title: Compact audit exports with privacy gates for analytics pipelines
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Goal: implement an auditable, compact export path from Console usage pipelines that enforces privacy gates before any downstream retention or archive. This ticket delivers a backend service (export-gate) plus pipeline transforms to produce minimal-PII audit bundles for compliance teams and external regulators while preserving developer debugability for incidents.
acceptance_criteria: Export-gate service implemented and deployed to staging with feature flag
Pipeline transforms apply selectable privacy gates (mask, hash, redact, encrypt) and emit export bundles <= 200KB per request on average
Automated test coverage for gate combinations and an invariant test asserting no cleartext user identifiers in 'compact_audit' topic
Conformance run against compliance checklist in Confluence (link below) passes
A rollout plan with canary on 5% of traffic and metrics dashboard (slo: 0 false negatives for PII) documented
comments: 2026-02-25 - Aisha Raman: initial writeup. Observability owners: add cost estimate for additional Kafka retention for 'compact_audit' topic.

2026-03-01 - Marcus Li: spike completed. Proof-of-concept service can take existing events and produce a compact export where identifiers are one of: ephemeral-id, sha256(user_email), or encrypted blob (AES-GCM with KMS key). Recorded trade-offs: hashing aids searchability but is revocable only with a mapping store; encryption is reversible only by holder of key but increases operational burden.
2026-03-03 - Security (Priya Shah): request for threat model and KMS usage pattern. Also asked to add key-rotation acceptance criteria. Assigned security_review_required=true.

2026-03-05 - Marcus Li: added retention gate matrix to spec: SOURCE_RAW -> [MASK_EMAIL, HASH_ID, ENCRYPT_SENSITIVE, DROP_PAYLOAD] -> COMPACT_AUDIT. Implementing as streaming transform (ksql/beam) is feasible; prefer Go service to centralize logic and keep deterministic outputs.
2026-03-07 - Design (Lena Ortiz): review feedback: add examples for audit reviewers showing redacted vs hashed vs encrypted exports; request a CSV sample for manual audits.
2026-03-10 - Marcus Li: PR opened for the export-gate service and unit tests. Link to PR in links. Starting canary rollout tomorrow on staging cluster with 2-day observation window.
notes: Design decision: we will not store reversible plaintext mappings in long-term storage. For cases that require re-identification by compliance, use an expirable mapping service (separate ticket).

Implementation detail: export-gate produces two outputs: compact_audit (privacy-gated) and debug_enclave (encrypted blobs with limited retention). Both streams have independent retention policies enforced by the pipeline operator.

Migration plan: step 1 - deploy service and run in read-only mode to shadow current exports; step 2 - enable write to compact_audit for 5% of traffic; step 3 - incrementally increase after 72h without privacy regressions. Rollback: route exports back to legacy topic and flag incident.
KPIs to track: false_negative_piis_detected (should be 0), average_export_size, per-export-encryption-rate, canary_error_rate. Set alert if false_negative_piis_detected > 0 or canary_error_rate > 1%.
Follow-ups: create a small runbook for CS/Legal to request re-identification via the expirable mapping service; separate ticket for mapping (PM to scope).
